supportingSources.label: Mike Lukianoff at the Big Bang Bar tutorial

strategy.summary: Choose a controllable bar mode, start it at the main ramp, then spell B-R-A-W-L and collect three ramp locks. During Multi-Brawl, repeat the ramp and take the inner-orbit Double Jackpot only from control.

quickInfo.name: Bar modes
quickInfo.summary: Bumpers rotate the selection; the center three-bank or lit inlane qualifies the flashing mode, and the main ramp starts it.

quickInfo.name: Multi-Brawl
quickInfo.summary: Spell B-R-A-W-L at the captive balls, lock three balls by the ramp, then use ramp and inner-orbit jackpots.

quickInfo.name: Looped in Space
quickInfo.summary: Complete both drop banks, lock two balls in the alien mouths, then clear both banks for its Jackpot.

quickInfo.name: The Big Bang
quickInfo.summary: Finish all nine modes and five features to light the timed four-ball wizard multiball at the one-bank.

steps.text: Use the opening save to test the main ramp, inner orbit, and both drop-bank rebounds.
Let the bumpers rotate to a mode whose shots are safe, then qualify it with the center bank or lit inlane.
Shoot the main ramp to start the qualified mode and complete its lit objectives.
Hit the captive balls to spell B-R-A-W-L, then use the main ramp to collect each Multi-Brawl lock.
During Multi-Brawl, repeat the main ramp for jackpots and use the inner orbit for a double jackpot when controlled.
After multiball, finish another unplayed bar mode or a nearby feature instead of repeating completed mode qualification.
modeNotes: Big Bang qualification: Every bar mode and each of the five untimed features must be finished before the one-bank lights the wizard.

fallback.title: Looped in Space
fallback.when: Use this when captive-ball hits or Multi-Brawl lock returns are unsafe.

steps.text: Complete the left four-bank and center three-bank.
Shoot the ramp to collect each lit alien lock and start Looped in Space.
Clear both banks for its jackpot while the extra ball protects the rebounds.

alternatives.title: Bathroom and mode selection
alternatives.when: Use this when no mode is qualified and the ramp return is repeatable.

steps.text: Leave the mode unqualified and shoot the ramp for the next Bathroom award.
Use bumper hits to rotate away from an unsafe mode.
Use the center bank or lit inlane to qualify the chosen mode only after its required feeds are proven, then start it at the ramp.
Play and finish every bar mode.
Complete Looped in Space, Multi-Brawl, Ray's Ball Busters, Tube Dancer, and Underground.
Hit the lit one-bank to start the timed four-ball Big Bang.
Manually relaunch drained balls and keep as many active as possible; target and Jackpot scoring scales with balls in play.

techniques.name: Mode selection through bumpers
techniques.instruction: Before qualifying a mode, use bumper hits to rotate to an objective whose shots are safe on this copy.

cautions.issue: A rejected main-ramp shot can return toward the center drain.
cautions.response: Do not force locks or modes until the ramp make point and saver behavior are known.

cautions.issue: Alien locks, ramp diverters, and the inner-orbit exit can malfunction or trap balls.
cautions.response: Confirm switches and physical routing before treating missing locks or delayed releases as normal rules.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm Capcom or authorized PMI copy, installed ROM, family or adult setting, ball save, extra-ball conversion, and tournament adjustments.
Test both ramp diverters, alien-mouth locks, captive balls, drop banks, inner-orbit exit, and the lock post above the left slingshot.
Confirm mode-completion lamps, alien releases, lock memory, and whether Big Bang drains return to the plunger for manual relaunch.
strategy.simpleOverview: Big Bang Bar uses the bumpers and center bank to select and qualify bar modes, while captive-ball hits spell B-R-A-W-L for Multi-Brawl. Start a controllable mode at the main ramp, then collect three ramp locks and repeat the ramp for Jackpots during Multiball.
strategy.overview: Finishing all nine bar modes and all five untimed features lights The Big Bang, Big Bang Bar's final four-ball Multiball. Use bumper hits to select a mode whose shots are safe, qualify it at the center bank or lit inlane, and start it at the main ramp. Spell B-R-A-W-L and collect three ramp locks for the repeatable Multiball route, using the inner-orbit Double only from control.
